subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

Please ask the dog to __get of my__ couch.
solution:
The correct answer is: **get off my**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is "**off**".
 
• "**Get of mine**" and "**get off mine**" are incorrect because "**mine**" is a possessive pronoun and cannot be used as an object of a preposition.
 
• The correct possessive pronoun to use is "**my**" because the speaker is referring to their own couch.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence**: *Please ask the dog to get off my couch. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**get of mine**" is grammatically incorrect because it uses the wrong preposition and the wrong possessive pronoun.
 
• "**get off mine**" is also grammatically incorrect because it uses the wrong possessive pronoun.
 
• "**No substitution**" is not applicable because the underlined segment needs to be corrected.
